correctness.rationale: From the row-stochastic transition kernel the stationary weights are (1,s,s,s)/(1+3s), and each edge current is s(p-q)/(1+3s). Exact expansion of every binary four-word probability gives four nonzero reversal pairs of equal magnitude pq s |p-q| (1-s)/(1+3s) and two zero pairs, yielding 4 times that magnitude as total variation. At p=q microscopic detailed balance, at s=1 observable-preserving reflection of the reversed chain, at pq=0 an alternating independent-run renewal process; these prove full-path reversibility on all zero surfaces. A singleton label class for every <=3 state Markov chain gives the minimality theorem. Separate one-variable derivatives prove both global optimum factors, with equality attained at s=1/3 and |p-q|=(p+q)/sqrt3. Replayed checker verifies all symbolic identities and 46 independent rational microscopic-path enumerations; finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact minimal-sized physical model of coarse-state molecular-motor readout, showing complete hidden-current invisibility under uniform rates and even wholly directed travel. A single localized departure defect and bidirectional hopping create the first observable finite-word time arrow. The complete parameter iff theorem, exact TV-current factorization and two-parameter globally sharp visibility optimum provide a motivated benchmark for designing coarse spectral-free temporal measurements, not a trivial renaming or arbitrary slice. The conclusion deliberately excludes finite-sample sensitivity and full entropy-production reconstruction.
